judgment_calls: Signet blank is brass, 8-sided, blank face (no engraving) to stay distinct from seal-engraver matrix/seal blanks.
Ribbon spool uses 5-sided flanges and an open (uncapped) ribbon tube; bottom flange has no underside cap (ground-facing) to stay under 40 tris.
Wax dish is an open flared bowl (single-sided) with a tab handle; holds no wax so it does not overlap wax-stick/wax-cake props.
Textures are flat 64px BaseColor swatches matching material colours.

assets.name: prop-signet-blank-sm3
assets.desc: Small unfinished brass signet blank: 8-sided disc 24 mm wide, 4 mm thick, slightly chamfered top, plain unengraved face.

assets.name: prop-seal-press-screw-sm3
assets.desc: Short hand seal press: oak base block 100x70x30 mm, 6-sided oak screw column 24 mm dia rising to 150 mm, iron T-handle bar 110 mm across near the top.

assets.name: prop-wax-warming-dish-sm3
assets.desc: Shallow iron wax-warming dish: open 8-sided flared bowl 100 mm across the rim, 70 mm base, 18 mm deep, single flat tab handle 35 mm long on one side.

assets.name: prop-ribbon-spool-sm3
assets.desc: Small seal-ribbon spool: two 5-sided oak flanges ~48 mm across (50 mm circumscribed), 6 mm thick, with a red ribbon wind ~36 mm across between them; total height 44 mm.
